data.description:
## Description

**What**: /dso:implementation-plan conditional load gated by epic's strata:scoped tag (inherited via story → epic chain — read story's parent epic). When gated open, Reads all three facts + guidance/implementation-plan.md (~240 lines). Task output references SDK generator commands with hyphenated flags (`strata:application_form --application-form` not `--application_form`).
**Why**: Implementation-plan tasks must reference SDK commands when scoped; flags must be hyphenated per upstream silent-ignore behavior on underscored flags.
**Scope**:
- IN: Story → epic tag inheritance; ~240-line conditional Read; SDK generator command references; hyphenated flag enforcement in generated tasks.
- OUT: Brainstorm/preplanning loads (S4/S5).

## Done Definitions
- When complete, on Strata-scoped story, implementation-plan Reads all three facts + implementation-plan-guidance ← Satisfies: SC2
- When complete, tag inherited via story → epic chain (parent lookup) ← Satisfies: SC2
- When complete, on Strata-scoped task input (e.g., "scaffold intake form for SnapApp"), generated task references SDK generator command with hyphenated flags — not equivalent manual Rails steps ← Satisfies: SC6
- When complete, on non-Strata or strata.skip=true, zero SDK Reads ← Satisfies: SC2
- When complete, unit tests written and passing for inheritance + SDK command output

## Considerations
- [Reliability] Tag inheritance must handle missing/malformed parent gracefully (treat as no tag)
- [Maintainability] Hyphenated flag enforcement is a content-rule on generated task text

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As /dso:implementation-plan, tag inheritance via story -> epic chain + SDK-aware task output
